primitive_record.meaning: Exact rule witness excludes physical references. Ordered formula list preserves repeats. All witnesses/premises/output scoped and bounded, then original kernel.command invoked with canonical local refs. Canonical literal identity preimage contains complete binding, exact witness and ordered premise formulas. No discovery-order formula codes or alpha quotient. Suitable for a future literal old-recipe embedding pass; no old payload is loaded here.
primitive_record.outcomes: Return status MEMBER only on complete kernel-validated membership. OutsideLanguage(ValueError) has reason/evidence for definite OUT_OF_PROFILE. MembershipUnknown(TimeoutError), any raw callback TimeoutError, or other incomplete computation is unresolved; it is never an exclusion. The API does not convert these exceptions into false booleans.

language.fresh: Substitution copies original43b capture/shadowing behavior. Complete all-name census precedes deterministic first-free suffix. Only complete suffix>=32 yields OUT_OF_PROFILE_FRESH_NAMESPACE with used-name evidence. Depth/time/visit/resource failures remain UNKNOWN.
language.hole: First hole suffix absent from complete original variable-name set plus parameters; atomic eq/pred templates can have zero/one/repeated occurrences. Same term/formula bounds apply.
language.legacy_embedding: Separate future all-old-formula/all-old-recipe pass required. No complete embedding claimed from bounds or static Source checks.
language.membership_vs_enumeration: Carrier is all eligible finite syntax, independent of known facts or target demand. This module decides individual supplied primitive records; it does not enumerate the entire carrier or prove total counts/absence/singletons.
language.node_measure: One node for each var, fun, bot, eq, pred, all, not, imp, and, or constructor; include all term nodes in formula size. Symbol spelling and argument arrays add no nodes.
language.rules: All six original rules only: original named axiom, original indexed Gamma, UI for any eligible universal and parameter term, atomic equality transport, ordered MP, whole-formula UG under complete original Gamma side condition. No finite generator phase restriction.
language.scoping: Parameter terms use only declared parameters. Formula terms may use lexically active literal binders. Binder namespace is complete original logical input variable-name set plus fresh0..fresh31. Extracted contextual bodies are syntax, never facts. Literal spelling and shadowing retained.
language.whole_input_gate: Validate every original axiom (closed), every occurrence-ordered Gamma entry (free vars original parameters), and exact closed target before complete object publication; reject whole profile input, never omit an original alternative.

incomplete_choices: Only input/actually known-fact parameter subterms, not all bounded terms.
Only known-universal UI, not arbitrary zero-input universal syntax.
Only single/all occurrence templates, not all arbitrary atom templates/subsets.
Oriented equality only; no shortcut symmetry/reflexivity/induction.
Vacuous UG omitted, although admitted by membership.
One lowest encountered proof-DAG cost per formula can lose sharing alternatives.
Fact/term/template/round/proposal/word bounds, generic ordering and resource failure can miss a proof.
proposer.initial_facts: Only actual original named axioms and occurrence-indexed Gamma; target/subtrees are syntax hints, never facts.
proposer.proof_candidate: Expanded original primitive command ancestry only, at most24, no saved donor/body/library input. Candidate must be isolated and rechecked with fresh private membership and independently unchanged1717 against freshly authenticated original theory/parameters/Gamma/target under same G/D.
proposer.search: Generic MP; known-universal UI with retained parameter subterms; generic oriented equality transport on known atom single/all matching-subterm contexts; UG of known whole formulas. Every macro creates unchanged primitive witnesses and real ancestry, then emits strict-prior expanded word.
proposer.unknown: Quiet worklist or any heuristic stop is UNKNOWN with candidate null, never finite-language exhaustion. Resource TimeoutError propagates as unresolved work; cold caller final native gates remain mandatory.

purpose: A generic implicit bounded primitive membership relation and an incomplete on-demand conventional positive-word proposer. This is not a GCTS engine, catalogue/count certificate, family library, finite Wang palette or RL learner.

trust_boundary: Producer and all its exposed objects/counters are untrusted. A Source seal alone does not protect mutable argument data. Cold intake must reauthenticate original raw inputs and reconstruct private language after producer; isolate/strictly bound candidate, full Source seals before/after authority delegates, then membership and unchanged1717 full-word check. No resource callback acts as an acceptance seal.
